name: Subtitle bar
oneliner: Clean captions in a solid bar, like TV subtitles.
description: Readable over busy backgrounds: job sites, kitchens, street corners.
prompt: VERBATIM captions grouped by phrase (up to 32 characters per line, max 2 lines). Each phrase sits in a bar: {{brand.primary}} at 88% opacity (fallback #111 at 80%), corner radius 20px, padding 22px 34px, width hugging the text, centered on x=540, bottom edge at y=1580. Text: {{font.body}} 700, 68-76px, white; numbers and names in {{brand.accent}}. The bar resizes between phrases with a 150ms ease-out, no bounce. Do NOT put the bar below y=1600 (platform UI lives there) and do NOT use a full-width black strip.
